summary: scripts/st-test keys its pool of persistent worktrees and kept cargo targets by the repository's normalised origin URL instead of by clone, so a fresh or throwaway clone takes a warm slot at the same path (re-registered as its own worktree, kept inputs moved across) instead of building a 35-44 GB target of its own; a clone without an origin keeps a pool of its own. The old per-clone pool directories are evicted by the pool cap.

replay.detail: st-test pool layout only (a local pre-sign script); no protocol, schema, policy, workflow or note change.

manual.detail: None: the first run per origin starts a new pool; the old per-clone directories under ~/.cache/st-test are removed by the pool cap or by hand.

recovery.detail: ST_TEST_TREES=off runs in a fresh worktree as before.
